description: While the results weren’t what we hoped for, I’m deeply grateful for every volunteer, donor, and supporter who stood with our campaign. We ran a race grounded in respect, hard work, and hope for Minnesota’s future — and that work isn’t over.

title: Gratitude, Respect, and the Road Ahead — Heather Holmes for MN House 24A
